topic: CD diffraction with a laser pointer
hook: Your old CD can turn one laser into a wall of dots.
title: Your Old CD Turns One Laser Into Dots
description:
Point a laser pointer at the shiny side of an old CD and a pattern of dots appears on the wall. The disc's tracks are about 1.6 micrometres apart, so they split the light. Never point a laser at anyone's eyes, and don't look into the reflection.

#Shorts #Science #Tech
comment_prompt: Got an old CD at home? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your old CD can turn one laser into dots.
scenes.headline: One Laser, Many Dots

scenes.narration: Point a laser pointer at its shiny side.

scenes.narration: Now look at the wall behind it.
scenes.headline: Check The Wall

scenes.narration: A pattern of bright dots appears.

scenes.narration: The disc's tiny tracks split the light.
scenes.headline: Tracks Split The Light

scenes.narration: Those tracks sit about 1.6 micrometres apart.
scenes.headline: Track Spacing

scenes.narration: That is far thinner than a human hair.
scenes.headline: Thinner Than Hair

scenes.narration: One laser, one old disc, a wall of dots.
scenes.headline: Wall Of Dots
